contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C M AVR ALEXAND AVG ; R/ P M TR P IIII COS P PA

A silver Denarius of Severus Alexander dating from AD 225 (Reece period 11). Cf. RIC 4 (Alexander), 50. Obverse inscription IMP C M AVR ALEXAND AVG, reverse inscription P M TR P IIII COS P PA. Diameter 19mm
